patch_description: Uses the parameter economy of the current one-angle-per-repeat design while retaining the collective RY layer and CZ entangling backbone from the stronger low-loss crossover candidate. The constrained tied RZ layer is removed: it adds 48 gates across six repeats without adding parameters and may interfere with optimization when forced to share the RY angle. The candidate keeps the minimum achievable circuit parameter count of six, eight parameters including readout, while reducing gate count from 138 to 90 and shortening circuit depth.
